about_short_description.short_description: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank offers personal and business banking services to the customers.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Current, savings, call, fixed deposit and offshore accounts for everyday banking, saving and cash management needs.

product.name: Personal Loans and Finance
product.description: Personal borrowing solutions that provide funding for individual expenses, financial needs and planned purchases.

product.name: Home Loans and Mortgage Solutions
product.description: Residential financing for purchasing, constructing or refinancing property, including selected solutions for off-plan homes.

product.name: Credit Cards
product.description: Personal credit cards for purchases, cash access, instalment plans, rewards, cashback and travel-related benefits.

product.name: Debit Cards
product.description: Debit cards linked to ADCB accounts for point-of-sale, online and ATM transactions in the UAE and internationally.

product.name: Business Accounts and Account Services
product.description: Transaction accounts and account services for small businesses, commercial companies, corporates and institutional customers.
